summary: Roll a number of d10 equal to your dice pool against a difficulty from 2 to 10. Each die meeting or exceeding the difficulty is a success. Ones cancel successes. If no successes remain and at least one 1 was rolled, the result is a botch.
notes: This app resolves standard V20 success, failure, and botch outcomes locally.
Special cases such as automatic successes, split actions, and full combat exchanges are deferred to later milestones.
